reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  -- one row per lead created in the first half of 2025
  SELECT lead_id, source
  FROM leads
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
),
funnel AS (
  -- one row per source
  SELECT c.source, COUNT(*) AS leads, COUNT(o.opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won) AS won,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won), 0) AS won_amount
  FROM cohort AS c
  LEFT JOIN opportunities AS o ON o.lead_id = c.lead_id
  GROUP BY c.source
),
spend AS (
  -- one row per paid channel
  SELECT channel, SUM(spend_eur) AS spend
  FROM marketing_spend_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT f.source, f.leads,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.opportunities / f.leads, 1) AS lead_to_opp_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.won / NULLIF(f.opportunities, 0), 1) AS opp_to_won_pct,
       f.won, ROUND(f.won_amount, 2) AS won_amount,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.spend, 0), 2) AS spend,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.spend, 0) / NULLIF(f.won, 0), 2) AS cost_per_won
FROM funnel AS f
LEFT JOIN spend AS s ON s.channel = f.source
ORDER BY f.won DESC, f.source

WITH funnel AS (
  -- one row per source, from the leads created in the first half of 2025
  SELECT l.source, COUNT(*) AS leads,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opportunities,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_won THEN o.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS won_amount
  FROM leads AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities AS o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY l.source
),
with_spend AS (
  -- one row per source, with its paid media from January to June 2025
  SELECT f.*,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.spend_eur)
                   FROM marketing_spend_monthly AS m
                   WHERE m.channel = f.source
                     AND m.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-01'), 0) AS spend
  FROM funnel AS f
)
SELECT source, leads,
       ROUND(100.0 * opportunities / leads, 1) AS lead_to_opp_pct,
       CASE WHEN opportunities > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * won / opportunities, 1) END AS opp_to_won_pct,
       won, ROUND(won_amount, 2) AS won_amount, ROUND(spend, 2) AS spend,
       CASE WHEN won > 0 THEN ROUND(spend / won, 2) END AS cost_per_won
FROM with_spend
ORDER BY won DESC, source

WITH cohort AS (
  -- one row per lead created in the first half of 2025, with a 1 for each later stage it reached
  SELECT l.lead_id, l.source,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities AS o WHERE o.lead_id = l.lead_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_opp,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities AS o WHERE o.lead_id = l.lead_id AND o.is_won) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_won,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.amount_eur) FROM opportunities AS o WHERE o.lead_id = l.lead_id AND o.is_won), 0) AS won_amount
  FROM leads AS l
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
),
funnel AS (
  -- one row per source
  SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS leads, SUM(has_opp) AS opportunities, SUM(is_won) AS won, SUM(won_amount) AS won_amount
  FROM cohort
  GROUP BY source
),
spend AS (
  -- one row per paid channel
  SELECT channel, SUM(spend_eur) AS spend
  FROM marketing_spend_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY channel
)

       ROUND(100.0 * f.opportunities / f.leads, 1) AS lead_to_opp_pct,

       ROUND(COALESCE(s.spend, 0), 2) AS spend,

  SELECT f.*,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.spend_eur)
                   FROM marketing_spend_monthly AS m
                   WHERE m.channel = f.source

  FROM funnel AS f
)
SELECT source, leads,
       ROUND(100.0 * opportunities / leads, 1) AS lead_to_opp_pct,
       CASE WHEN opportunities > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * won / opportunities, 1) END AS opp_to_won_pct,

WITH l AS (
  SELECT lead_id, source FROM leads
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
), f AS (
  SELECT l.source, COUNT(*) AS leads,
         COUNT(o.lead_id) AS opps,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won) AS won,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won), 0) AS won_amount
  FROM l LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  GROUP BY l.source
), sp AS (
  SELECT channel, SUM(spend_eur) AS spend FROM marketing_spend_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month <= DATE '2025-06-01'
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT f.source, f.leads,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.opps / f.leads, 1) AS lead_to_opp_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.won / NULLIF(f.opps, 0), 1) AS opp_to_won_pct,
       f.won,
       ROUND(f.won_amount, 2) AS won_amount,
       ROUND(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0), 2) AS spend,
       ROUND(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0) / NULLIF(f.won, 0), 2) AS cost_per_won
FROM f LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.channel = f.source
ORDER BY f.won DESC, f.source
